title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Every position in this record is paper. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. A single trade, whether it wins or loses, does not say anything about a strategy. This article reports the live paper record as it stands, with no projection. The snapshot used here was read at 2026-11-04T02:23:24.196Z.

## Live starts and first signals

The live record starts on different dates for the two trend-daily engines. v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026, and v006 counts its live record from 9 October 2026. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066, taken after the 10 October 2026 daily close. That position later exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703. The measured result is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The rule here is an exit below the 10-day low; the measurement is the closing price of 1.703; the outcome is the -17.9% result after costs. A separate NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. In testing, a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise, and the average winner was roughly +19%. That expectation is context only; it is not a prediction for any open or future trade.

## Engine status on 4 November 2026

htf-rsi-v007 has 0 positions open on paper. It has 4 closed trades so far, with an average null net per trade. The record does not provide a numeric average for those 4 closed trades beyond "null", so no further arithmetic is made here.

trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter on. It has 0 positions open on paper. It has 5 closed trades so far, with an average of -13.68% net per trade. With the filter on and 0 positions open, the engine is not currently holding a paper position in this record.

trend-daily-v006 also has the Bitcoin market filter on. It has 1 position open on paper: HYPEUSDT, open since 30 October 2026. It has 5 closed trades so far, with an average of -13.68% net per trade. The difference between the two trend-daily engines in this snapshot is that v006 holds 1 open paper position while v005 holds 0.

## Distance to 20-day breakouts

These figures describe how far each named market is from its 20-day breakout level in the current record. They are measurements, not signals to act.

For trend-daily-v005, the closest names to their 20-day breakout are:
- UNIUSDT is 3.15% below its high.
- XRPUSDT is 6.50% below its high.
- BCHUSDT is 7.26% below its high.

For trend-daily-v006, the closest names to their 20-day breakout are:
- UNIUSDT is 3.15% below its high.
- HYPEUSDT is 5.29% below its high.
- XRPUSDT is 6.50% below its high.

The same UNIUSDT and XRPUSDT distances appear in both lists. HYPEUSDT appears in the v006 list while BCHUSDT appears in the v005 list. These are the closest recorded distances; the record does not state why a name is or is not currently held.

## Closed trades and the market filter

The market filter is on for both trend-daily engines. In this snapshot, that condition coincides with 0 open positions for v005 and 1 open position for v006. The record shows correlation only; it does not establish that the filter caused either count.

The closed-trade record is short. trend-daily-v005 and trend-daily-v006 each show 5 closed trades with an average of -13.68% net per trade. htf-rsi-v007 shows 4 closed trades with an average null net per trade. ATOM, the first live signal, is one of the closed trades and ended at -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. NEAR remains open from 12 October 2026. Because the sample is small, these averages describe what has happened in the record so far; they do not describe what will happen.

## Where to check the same numbers

The record updates continuously. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. This article is a reading of that record at one point in time, not a forecast.
